objective: Port every Windows application feature, including UI and remaining managed Mod readers/watchers, to Rust while preserving the Electron edition; compare memory again after full migration.
scope: Application logic and UI source must be Rust. Generated WebAssembly interoperability glue and existing third-party native libraries are allowed. No application feature may require the React/TypeScript UI, a C# helper, or the Node compatibility backend. Electron source, settings and delivered artifacts are preserved.

Actual 32-bit game, every role, multi-person internet voice, Bluetooth, device removal, sleep/resume and long sessions remain unverified.
No real inquiry/BAN/admin submission or installer execution was performed during this update.
.NET memory is reference-only: playback buffer warnings and/or less decoded microphone audio than the matched 30-second window.
HTML selects, sliders and other controls have browser rendering differences; no pixel-identical claim.
Debug/history dialogs and every Mod state need additional visual verification.
Synthetic smoke is a bounded stability check, not a matched Electron/.NET benchmark. Existing final comparison remains beta8.
completionCriteria: All existing application/UI features run from Rust implementations.
